The current implementation passes the query in input_data but leaves params empty, causing execution failure. I will fix action_1 to extract the query from input_data and set it as a plain string in params['query'].

Set params['query'] to this extracted string as a plain string, not expression.

Test the action_1 to confirm the query executes successfully.
